quoi: Run of the two real tools of "JSM Portal Answers" against the real portal, with the questions a judge asks (several words, one phrase)
transport: asUser() proxied to the REST API of the site with the caller credentials; every call is a GET, asApp() throws

plusieurs_mots.reponse:
JSM Portal Answers — read-only answers about a JSM customer portal
Question: "my laptop is broken"

Portal: Support (SUP)
  Service desk id: 1 | project key: SUP | project type: service_desk
  Categories of this portal: Common Requests, Computers, Logins and Accounts, Applications, Servers and Infrastructure
  No request type contains the words "my laptop is broken" as one phrase (the server-side searchQuery filter). These request types contain at least one of the words laptop, broken, best match first:
  Request types (1):
    - Report broken hardware [id 9]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Common Requests, Computers, Servers and Infrastructure | portal id: 1
      Description: Report hardware that might be faulty or broken e.g. a broken computer screen or a damaged server.
  Rules of this portal:
    - a request can be raised on behalf of another person: yes
    - participants can be added to a request: yes
  SLA targets: the public JSM REST API does not expose the SLA targets of a portal (its only SLA endpoints describe one request that already exists). The fields of the form are described by the other tool, describe_request_type_form.

Identity: the portal was read with your own Jira permissions, so you see the request types you are allowed to see. Nothing was written, nothing was stored.
